description: This file defines the LowOrderFee class, which extends a core Model class in OpenCart. It implements the getTotal method to add a low order fee to the cart total when the subtotal is below a configured threshold, including handling applicable taxes.

classes.name: LowOrderFee
classes.description: A model class responsible for calculating and adding a low order fee to the cart total if the subtotal is below a configured minimum threshold.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and adds a low order fee to the totals array if the cart's subtotal is below a specified threshold, including tax calculations.
